tasks_completed.description: Normalized Codex terminal rendering across inline, full detail, and sidebar surfaces.
tasks_completed.rationale: Addresses complete command/stdout/stderr/error/exit/status reachability without relying on bounded inline preview.

tasks_completed.description: Added explicit compact/full rendering for Codex plan/update and attachment/image payloads.
tasks_completed.rationale: Makes functions.update_plan, functions.view_image, and file envelopes visible with bounded summaries and inspectable detail/sidebar views.

tasks_completed.description: Made patch/diff inline cards compact while keeping full diffs available in detail/sidebar.
tasks_completed.rationale: Prevents multi-screen inline diff cards and preserves full patch/diff inspection where expanded.

tasks_completed.description: Bounded unknown/dynamic fallback previews and wrapped inspectable code blocks.
tasks_completed.rationale: Unknown, dynamic, MCP/resource, and falsy-result payloads remain safe to inspect without horizontal page overflow.

tasks_completed.description: Activated standalone markdown image parsing and added rich markdown fixture coverage.
tasks_completed.rationale: Completes markdown/rich coverage for headings, lists, task lists, blockquotes, code, links, entities, inline LaTeX, and images.

tasks_completed.description: Resolved app typecheck blockers encountered during validation.
tasks_completed.rationale: Keeps happy-app typecheck green after renderer changes; no daemon or production state touched.

git_rationale.root_cause_commit: N/A - BA diagnosed L2 renderer coverage gap, not a bisected code regression.
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: Prior work centered on CodexBash/Terminal and left non-Terminal Codex payload classes either generic, inline-heavy, or unmeasured.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: The app renderer matrix now has explicit terminal, patch/diff, plan/update, attachment/image, multi-tool, markdown/rich, and bounded fallback paths in happy-app.

diff_stats.justification_for_overage: The validated BA scope required multiple renderer classes plus representative fixtures/tests across Terminal, markdown/rich, patch/diff, plan/update, attachment/image, multi-tool, dynamic/MCP/resource, and unknown fallback surfaces. Shared utility extraction avoided repeating terminal/fallback parsing across inline/detail/sidebar.

dev.qa_notes: QA must rebuild/deploy happy-web-dev from this worktree and perform live desktop/mobile rendering verification. Dev intentionally did not claim live UI completion.

validation_outcomes.summary: 8 tests passed covering markdown/rich/images and representative Codex terminal, stderr/nonzero exit, patch/diff, nested fallback JSON, multi-tool, plan/update, and attachment/image fixtures.

self_verification.notes: Source/test validation only. No live UI, no Docker deploy, no daemon restart, and no production access were performed by dev.

codex_consult.feedback_summary: Codex flagged pre-existing happy-cli dirty files, lack of live UI evidence, possible detail-data loss from suppressing generic full sections, truthiness-based generic fallback gaps, attachment envelope proof, utility-heavy tests, multi-tool semantic depth, and real Codex patch/diff shapes.
codex_consult.feedback_incorporated: Adjusted ToolFullView so only CodexBash suppresses generic raw sections; fixed generic fallback to preserve falsy result payloads; made empty strings inspectable; enriched multi_tool_use.parallel rows with argument summaries; documented dirty happy-cli files as pre-existing/out of scope and live UI as QA responsibility.

remaining_risks: Live desktop/mobile happy-dev UI verification is still required by QA; dev did not rebuild/deploy or claim live UI closure.
Repository had pre-existing modified happy-cli Codex files before this task; this implementation did not modify them, but git status is not app-only clean.
Multi-tool nested child results are summarized inline and raw-inspectable in detail; QA should verify whether live Codex payloads need deeper child drill-down in a follow-up.
functions.apply_patch or other patch-like dynamic tool shapes that do not normalize to CodexPatch/CodexDiff rely on bounded generic fallback unless protocol maps them to registered patch/diff tools.
recommendations: QA should capture exact-target desktop 1440x900 and mobile 390x844 screenshots plus DOM overflow metrics for the BA payload matrix.
If QA finds dynamic patch/multi-tool payloads need richer nested drill-down, create a follow-up scoped to those real payload shapes after live evidence.
